title: The Video-Call Era
description: There were days when the only way I could see you was through a screen, pixelated and framed by a battery icon. I lost count of how many times I took a screenshot just because you were laughing, or because the light hit your face a certain way, or honestly, just because I didn't want the call to end. Every one of those photos is a captured second where I was sitting in my room, but my heart was wherever you were. Looking back at them now, I see more than just video calls; I see the late nights, the tired eyes, and the way we kept each other going even when the world felt far apart. We were building our own world, one screenshot at a time. Low resolution, but high emotion.
